title: Appeals and Grievances Clause: Payment at Issue on a Joining Late-Filed TRICARE Select Line
content:
**Appeals and Grievances — payment at issue on the joining line**

Clause. The payment at issue on the joining line is figured by one of three methods: where the other insurer's payment counted is at least the allowed amount at issue, no payment is at issue; where a payment by another insurer below the allowed amount at issue is counted, the cost share is figured on the allowed amount at issue less that payment and the payment at issue is that net amount less the cost share; in every other case the cost share is figured on the allowed amount at issue itself and the payment at issue is the allowed amount at issue less the cost share; each amount is rounded to the cent.

Scope: a further TRICARE Select posting of a claim joining an open Claim Factual Reconsideration on that claim, both carrying the late-filing denial. The tier whose schedule figures apply is the tier of the TRICARE Select enrollment the joining line was billed under.

| Other insurer's payment counted | Amount the cost share is figured on | Payment at issue |
|---|---|---|
| at least the allowed amount at issue (equal counts) | — | none (0.00) |
| above zero and below the allowed amount at issue | the allowed amount at issue less the payment counted | that net amount less the cost share |
| none | the allowed amount at issue | the allowed amount at issue less the cost share |

Hypothetical: allowed amount at issue 300.00, a 20 percent cost share.

- Counted 300.00: equal to the allowed amount, so no payment is at issue (0.00).
- Counted 350.00: above the allowed amount, so no payment is at issue (0.00).
- Counted 120.00: net 180.00; cost share 20 percent of 180.00 is 36.00; payment at issue 144.00.
- Nothing counted: cost share 20 percent of 300.00 is 60.00; payment at issue 240.00.
